description: Whether a record may enter a later quantitative analysis, and if not, why.
policy: Eligibility is a description attached to a record, never a deletion. Every record remains in the dataset. Per DD-11 the analysis decides which eligibility values it accepts; this field does not decide for it.

analysis_eligibility.definition: Complete, unambiguous, and usable without caveat.
analysis_eligibility.inclusion_rule: Role and site class both determined from source evidence, no unresolved dependency, no source conflict.

analysis_eligibility.definition: Usable, but carries a caveat an analysis must acknowledge.
analysis_eligibility.inclusion_rule: Determined role but a provisional site class, a construct caveat, or a low-sample family context.
analysis_eligibility.decision_logic: Per OD-10 low sample size and missing human receptors are warnings, never grounds for hiding a family.

analysis_eligibility.definition: A genuine part of the structure that is not pharmacology.
analysis_eligibility.inclusion_rule: Role is environment_ion, membrane_lipid, detergent, buffer_or_crystallization_additive or glycan_or_post_translational_component.
analysis_eligibility.decision_logic: Retained in the entity inventory; produces no pharmacological observation.

analysis_eligibility.definition: Present because of the engineered construct.
analysis_eligibility.inclusion_rule: Role is construct_stabilizer, fusion_partner, or antibody_or_nanobody used as a chaperone.

analysis_eligibility.definition: A biologically real partner that is not a receptor ligand.
analysis_eligibility.inclusion_rule: Role is transducer_component, auxiliary_protein or cofactor.
analysis_eligibility.decision_logic: Excluded from ligand pharmacology while remaining available for transducer analysis.

analysis_eligibility.definition: Cannot be judged automatically; a human must decide.
analysis_eligibility.inclusion_rule: Role or site class unresolved, sources in conflict, or a rule fired with low confidence.
analysis_eligibility.decision_logic: These records populate the manual review queue and are counted honestly rather than assumed correct.

vocabulary_status.policy: A value outside this file may not appear in any Phase 2 artefact. The test suite fails on an unknown value. Adding a value requires an entry in governance/DECISION_LOG.md.
